ambiguities: The paper is conceptual; horizon Weekly chosen to match the library.
Resource categories (objects, conditions, personal characteristics, energies) are abstract; the bundle instantiates them with the concrete kinds in the pilot vocabulary.
Loss spirals are self-loops on resource loss, which the kernel does not express as a proposition; encoded through strain.

overlap_warnings.message:
shares primitives Resource CareerSecurity, Resource SocialSupport with JobResources.security, JobResources.support
  Resources.conditions ~ JobResources.security : Resource CareerSecurity at Individual / Weekly
  Resources.support ~ JobResources.support : Resource SocialSupport at Individual / Weekly
  overlap kind: partial (2 of 6 primitive(s) of Resources, 2 of 5 of JobResources)
  resolve with: declare_overlap Resources distinct_from JobResources "reason" (or alias_of / subtype_of)
